text:
🇲🇽🏭 <u>4T ELIMINATES 1,711 FEDERAL PROCEDURES; 3,497 SIMPLIFIED — DIGITAL STATE BUILDS OUT</u>

Peña Merino at the mañanera today: 3,497 federal procedures simplified, 1,711 eliminated entirely — 60% of the way to the 4,500 goal by end of 2026.

Passports: 21 steps → 5. Civil registry: 28 → 20. Consular services: 72 → 37.

gob.mx now serves 56 million Mexicans; Llave MX digital ID has 24 million accounts; Mi Registro Civil 18 million. Full federal digitalization targeted Q1 2027 — the neoliberal paperwork labyrinth dismantled in real time.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>FIFA RENTED CHAPULTEPEC CASTLE FOR $1M PESOS — SHEINBAUM "I JUST WENT TO SAY HELLO"</u>

Sheinbaum cleared the air today: FIFA paid 1 million pesos to rent Mexico's most iconic castle for Infantino's pre-Mundial gala on June 10.

"Yo sólo fui a saludar y me retiré" — she was invited to Infantino's dinner but only delivered Mexico's message and left.

Castle gets rented for private events "for a long time, not new" — but Contralínea put it sharper this week: FIFA is the corporate state with market immunity.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>SCJN DECLARES GUARDERÍA ABC CRIMES IMPRESCRIPTIBLE — 17 YEARS LATER, JUSTICE OPENS</u>

SCJN ruled UNANIMOUSLY today: the crimes from the 2009 Guardería ABC fire never prescribe — 49 babies (3 months to 4 years old) burned alive in Hermosillo on Calderón's watch.

Ministra Loretta Ortiz: grave human rights violations against children don't expire. Ministras Batres y Ríos blamed the neoliberal model that privatized IMSS daycare services.

The ex-IMSS director who tried to evade trial by claiming the statute of limitations ran out — amparo denied, unanimously. 17 years of parent organizing finally hits the books.

🇲🇽🔍 "I was there myself. I spoke with the mayor." "In that security zone there is greater presence of the National Guard. I was there personally — I spoke with the municipal president and with local authorities." — Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, June 18, 2026 Sierra Tarahumara — one of Mexico's most isolated regions, home to the Rarámuri people. The strategy: address root causes, presence of the State, full respect for Indigenous communities. Result: 39 fewer homicides per day than in September 2024. Peace built with social justice, not war rhetoric.

🇲🇽🏭 "Our job is to convince the US that the best path is no tariffs." "Our work is convincing them that the best thing for the United States and for Mexico is that there be no tariffs. The USMCA was signed by the three economies and benefits all three." — Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, June 18, 2026 Mexico produces, exports, invests. North America's production chains support millions of jobs on both sides of the border. Breaking that integration is a US own-goal. Sheinbaum is not asking — she is explaining with numbers.

🇲🇽⚽ FIFA paid 1 million pesos to rent Chapultepec Castle. "The party at Chapultepec was organized and paid for by FIFA. FIFA rented it — I believe they paid more than a million pesos. I arrived a bit late, entered the castle, read a brief welcome and left. That was my participation. A welcome and a goodbye." — Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, June 18, 2026 World Cup 2026 kicks off in Mexico. The Castle is property of the Mexican people; rentals go to INAH, the public heritage institute. Sheinbaum dropped in, said hello, and went back to work. No spectacle.

🇲🇽✊ "Technology exists to make life easier — and to prevent corruption." "3,497 procedures simplified — 60% of the federal administration. 1,711 redundant processes eliminated. Average requirements down from 6 to 2. The portal gob.mx already used by 56 million Mexicans." — Pepe Merino & Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, June 18, 2026 The largest administrative simplification in Mexican history, on track to top 4,500 procedures by year-end. The neoliberal model turned every paperwork window into a chance to extort the citizen. The 4T is closing that window — by code, not by speech.

🇲🇽🌎 "We will always talk about the original peoples." "We don't know all the topics yet — he arrives Thursday the 25th in the afternoon. We will always talk about the original peoples, about the importance of the peoples of Mexico." — Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, June 18, 2026 King Felipe VI of Spain visits Palacio Nacional on June 25. Mexico has been clear: it expects Spain to publicly acknowledge the violence of the conquest against Indigenous peoples. Sheinbaum confirms the topic stays on the table — wherever the conversation goes.
